Grease the fanes of cooling system.

Check injection synchronization.

text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
These document out outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be 
 performed every three months by M3 in the title block.
Technical Specification:
Supplier | Detroit, Allison USA | Cummins
Type | V71 Engines 12 Cylinder, 2 Stroke Cycle | V903, V-378-F2, V-504, V-555
Function | For GT MS5001 Frame 5 | For Fire Fighting
Power | 500 HP | 136 HP
Speed | 2300 rpm | 2300 RPM
Bore | 4.25 inch | 
Stroke | 5 inch | 
Compression Ratio | 17 to 1 | 
Total Displacement | 852 cubic inch | 378 cubic inch
The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Abou El-Fetouh Shata, tested by 
 eng. Ali Abd Elslam, revised by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection & 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, accepted by general 
 director eng. Yosry Abd Elmaqsood, and approved by eng. Fathy Ragap head 
 sector of Talkha Power Station.
This document accepted by 
 eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: 
 EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman: EDEPC planning & financial 
 prediction head sector and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head 
 sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued,
The qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable safety ID category
Safety fence with caution marks to surround the work area 
 is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 earplug, gloves pairs, breathing mask, safety glasses ... etc
Be sure that the emergency diesel is out of service.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Measuring and checking tools.
Cleaning articles.
Magnetic pickup flexible.
Spray gun,
 Grease gun
Work to be Carried Out
Check engine oil, add or change it.
Check oil filter and clean it.
Inspect for oil leaks of connections, and treat any leakage.
Check fuel oil level, and readjust it.
Inspect coolant elements (water level leakage).
Check fuel strainer and fuel filter or change it.
Check the fuel pump and rotation of it.
Grease the fanes of cooling system.
Drain water and sediment from the fuel tank.
Drain water and sediment from the air tank.
Check air starting motor.
Clean air start screen and check the differential pressure.
Check injection synchronization.
